name: comp-431
blurb: Bordered segmented tabs with adjacent button styling.
description: Tabs styled as bordered segments with negative margin overlap. Appears like segmented control buttons with shared borders.
use_when: Toggle-like navigation requiring segmented button appearance.
avoid_when: Traditional or minimal tab styling; when you need distinct tab panels.
a11y: Semantic tabs with keyboard navigation via radix-ui Tabs component.
